coordinatorCatalogMerge.scope: Shared catalog merge for the 13 Omega references established as absent from the previous complete captures and present in the 2026-10-08 official AT/HK/JP/KR category captures.
coordinatorCatalogMerge.identityAndCollection: Each item uses watchId omega:<full reference>, collectionId seamaster, and the exact official Hong Kong image asset URL without its thumbnail-width query.
coordinatorCatalogMerge.dialColorSource: Official Hong Kong product images reviewed at full resolution. AT category text explicitly labels 210.83.42.20.01.001 grey and 220.10.38.20.02.004 silver; remaining clear colors use the documented HK image review.

normalizationDecision.basis: The official images show pale metallic dials but cannot reliably distinguish white from silver. Silver is used as a best-fit catalog filter slug to satisfy the existing required non-empty dialColors field; for 220.10.38.20.02.004 the AT official category title says Silber. The remaining ambiguity is preserved in observations.json imageReview.
normalizationDecision.caveat: This is a catalog filter normalization, not a claim that all three official localized pages explicitly call the dial silver. Moonshine Gold case/bracelet material was not used to infer dial color.
